name: Derivative as Slope
summary: A dark-navy graph where a curve is drawn and a point slides along it, its tangent and slope readout updating.
bestFor: Calculus intros, tutoring channels, course teasers
prompt: Explain what a derivative is. Draw a smooth curve on a graph, slide a point along it with its tangent line, and show the slope number changing from negative to positive. Then trace the slope itself as a second curve, so the idea that the derivative is the rate of change becomes visible.
